episodes.175936: As a warm front moved inland and the center of low pressure shifted into southeast Georgia, a line of thunderstorms developed in the evening hours. These thunderstorms produced strong wind gusts, including one report of damage in Liberty County.
episodes.175937: A strong line of thunderstorms impacted the southeast Georgia and southeast South Carolina coast with strong wind gusts during the evening hours. The line of thunderstorms eventually moved out into the open Atlantic coastal waters and continued to produce strong wind gusts.
episodes.176026: A warm front lifted northward across SE GA during the morning and placed the entire forecast area within the warm sector ahead of an approaching pre-frontal squall line. Strong SSW speed shear was over the area with 0-6 km bulk shear 50-60 kts across SE GA to 40-50 kts southward across NE FL. Warm and unstable conditions pushed northward to near Waycross into the afternoon with ML CAPE 1000-1500 J/kg as the pre-frontal convection approached into the late afternoon and early evening. Strong to severe storms moved across the local area during the late afternoon and early evening producing wind damage and a couple of tornadoes in SE GA.

episodes.176068: Low pressure, tracking from the New Jersey coast to Nantucket, produced heavy, wet snow that was pretty much confined to the higher elevations in western and northern Massachusetts.  The weight of the snow, especially when combined with snow from a few days prior, caused some tree damage.  There was also coastal flooding around the time of high tide in eastern Massachusetts.
